If a screen asks the learner to do two things, it does neither.
https://ka-performancefl.com/training/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-09-30-5

The screens in this Short come from our free safety sample course. The inspection board shows every location; tap one, make a single call, hold the work or let it go, and the feedback lands on that one decision.

One decision per screen. That is how we design training people finish.

The music is AI generated. The course screens are real captures.

K&A Performance builds websites for small businesses in Gainesville and North Florida.
